integrity: The primary 2026 paper and its exact supplementary cyclic-order code were inspected, the 2025 predecessor was checked for implication-level overlap, the complete finite calculation was independently replayed from the published cyclic data, and statement-level semantic/public searches were compared before acceptance.
scientific_limitations: The complete dual-neighbor census is proved for the explicit Table-2 cyclic-order data; moduli-wide constancy is not asserted.
A historically equivalent incidence census under classical cubic-surface terminology remains a residual originality risk.
The result concerns chamber-wall incidence and does not by itself imply new linear relations among canonical forms.
title: Dual adjacency census for the 130 positive chambers of an explicit real cubic surface
